# Feature: Setup writes potato.config.yaml after preview and confirm

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #13 -->

## Intent
Reproducibility needs versioned config; security needs consent. `potato init` shows a preview (config + `.gitignore` lines for `.potato/`) and writes only after `--confirm`. Abort leaves the repo untouched (FR-007, BR-001, SCN-011).

Roadmap: Epic 2 Web CLI — SCN-011.

## Preconditions
- `packages/cli` exists (#11)
- Read-only discovery exists (#12)

## Happy Path
- [ ] `potato init <root>` prints planned paths and a schema-valid config preview; no files are created
- [ ] `potato init <root> --confirm` writes `potato.config.yaml` with `adapterId`, `root`, and `commands.start` (argv array)
- [ ] Confirm also appends `.potato/` to `.gitignore` (creates the file if missing) and a local config-change log under `.potato/logs/`
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Abort / missing `--confirm` → zero writes (including no `.gitignore` and no log)
- [ ] Existing `potato.config.yaml` is not overwritten unless `--confirm` is passed
- [ ] Write paths are allowlisted under the canonical project root (P-04)

## Regression
- [ ] `potato detect` remains read-only
- [ ] `pnpm checks` stays green
- [ ] Scope: `packages/cli/**`, `packages/core/**`, `packages/schemas/**` — not `apps/dashboard`

## Assumptions
- Non-interactive confirm is `--confirm` (no TTY prompt); dashboard wizard is out of scope
- `commands.start` is an argv array, never a shell string
- Adapter id is the first non-unknown discovery candidate, else `unknown`

## Security Coverage
- F-01 N/A (CLI, no TLS)
- F-02: config validated with Zod `.strict()` before write; unknown keys rejected
- F-03/F-05: no secrets in schema or written YAML
- B-04: no SQL; no shell interpolation; argv arrays only
- P-02: CLI errors are `error.message` only
- P-04: `assertInsideRoot` on every write path
- Potato-Boost: discovery still read-only; writes only after `--confirm`

Not applicable (CLI).

## Implementation Notes
- `potato init [path]` always prints planned paths + YAML; writes only with `--confirm`.
- Schema: `packages/schemas/src/potato-config.ts` (strict; argv `commands.start`).
- Writer: `packages/core/src/config/` uses `assertInsideRoot` on every path.
- Audit line: `.potato/logs/config-change.log` (no secrets).
- 66 tests; `pnpm checks` green.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- Event: user confirms init → writer creates config, gitignore line, one audit log (cardinality 1).
- Without `--confirm` the writer is not called (0 files).
- No queue/worker/fan-out.
